Vaishno Devi Mandir Ulda Galudih: Jharkhand’s Hidden Spiritual Gem! | Vlog EP 27
Embark on a divine journey to Vaishno Devi Mandir, Ulda Galudih – a serene and lesser-known pilgrimage site near Ghatshila, Jharkhand. Nestled in the lap of nature, this sacred temple is a perfect retreat for devotees and travelers seeking peace, spirituality, and breathtaking views.
What You’ll Experience in This Vlog:
The history & spiritual significance of Vaishno Devi Mandir
A guided tour of the temple’s stunning architecture & divine sanctum
How to reach this sacred site from Ghatshila
